sources.entry: prophet - A tool for producing forecasts for time series with multiple seasonality and trend changes.

summary.one_liner: Prophet is an open-source forecasting library (R and Python) from Meta that fits additive time-series models with trend, yearly/weekly/daily seasonality, and holiday effects.
use_cases: forecast business metrics like sales or demand
model time series with weekly and yearly seasonality
add country or custom holiday effects to forecasts
run cross-validation on time series forecasts
forecast in R or Python with a single library
distributed forecasting on Apache Spark via Helter Skelter
notable: Additive model with non-linear trends, multiple seasonalities, and holiday effects, robust to missing data and trend shifts
Available on CRAN, PyPI, and conda-forge
Built-in cross-validation and performance metrics; custom metrics supported since 1.1.7
Helter Skelter: a Scala/Spark reimplementation of the core approach for distributed computing, developed by Amadeus
caveats: README states Prophet is in maintenance mode as of v1.4.0: only bug fixes, dependency bumps, and R/Python parity changes; no new features planned
CRAN version is outdated; the README recommends installing the latest release from GitHub
Windows needs a C++ toolchain (Rtools for R, mingw-gcc for Python); Linux VMs need at least 4GB RAM to install and 2GB to use
Works best with strong seasonal effects and several seasons of historical data
